summary: Data prefabs (component bags with extends/overrides), a Godot-style scene tree format, and Tiled / LDtk level importers.
useWhen: Levels or entity families described as data: hand-written scenes, prefabs shared across levels, or maps drawn in Tiled or LDtk.
limitations: Tiled: orthogonal maps, CSV/array tile data and embedded tilesets only; tile flip flags are ignored.
LDtk: levels embedded in the project file; tiles map by tile id only.
One entity per tile (no greedy merging of tile runs into larger colliders yet).
